First, 12 weeks + 7 days = 12×7 + 7 = 84 + 7 = 91 days.  
1408 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century year that’s not divisible by 400).  
From 05-28-1408, add 91 days:  
May has 31 days, so days left in May after 28th = 3 days (29,30,31) → 3 days used.  
91 − 3 = 88 days left.  
June 1408 has 30 days → 88 − 30 = 58 left.  
July has 31 days → 58 − 31 = 27 left.  
August 1 to August 27 = 27 days → date is August 27, 1408.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1408-08-27
